stories.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
stories.body: Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying British-made drones as the prime minister vows to support Kyiv in its "hour of need".

stories.title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
stories.body: A number of buildings and cars are damaged in the historic city, and the world famous Alhambra palace has temporarily closed.

stories.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
stories.body: Environmentalists have heavily criticised the exploratory drilling in the sea off the mouth of the Amazon.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
stories.body: Lindsay Clancy has admitted killing her daughter and two sons but has pleaded not guilty to murder, saying she was experiencing postpartum psychosis.

stories.title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
stories.body: Recovery efforts continue in what is the country's deadliest transport disaster.

stories.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
stories.body: Imran Khan has been imprisoned since 2023 on corruption charges which he says were politically motivated.

stories.title: Judge swapped in Trump's defamation case against BBC
stories.body: A judge who was recently nominated by the US president to serve in Florida's federal court will now preside over his $10bn defamation case against the BBC.

stories.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
stories.body: The former heavyweight boxing champion shares a child with the Heroes actress, who died on Sunday.

stories.title: Nigeria influencer arrested after seizure of cocaine worth $28m destined for the UK
stories.body: Afolabi Kazeem Micheal has not commented on allegations he is linked to a global drug trafficking network.

stories.title: Disney and ABC sue Trump's media regulator to stop early licence renewal
stories.body: The network accuses the administration of retaliating against ABC because it "disapproves of what ABC broadcasts".

stories.title: Man in Chucky-style mask terrorises Philadelphia residents
stories.body: "It was just weird, like some twisted game."

stories.title: US announces new sanctions on top ICC figures
stories.body: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the international court "brick by brick".

stories.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
stories.body: Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using sperm and egg donors which were not the ones selected by the parents.

stories.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
stories.body: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

stories.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
stories.body: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.

stories.title: Indian student leader ends hunger strike after 16 days
stories.body: Devendra Nath Mahto was part of a larger protest which began weeks ago, demanding exam reforms in Jharkhand state.

stories.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
stories.body: The alleged shooter, also a student, later took his own life.

stories.title: Zambia's Hichilema re-elected president as main rival in hiding over alleged threats
stories.body: Hakainde Hichilema says he was “truly humbled” by the victory and promised to work for all Zambians.

stories.title: Norway's king admitted to hospital and put on sick leave
stories.body: The 89-year-old - one of Europe's longest-serving monarchs - is suffering from a rare blood condition.

stories.title: Doctors remove 3.1kg stone from man's bladder and claim record
stories.body: The bladder stone, which weighs as much as a full-term baby, is believed to be the largest on record.
